label: adds-enum-fuel-units-issuing
content:
# Adds enum values for fuel units

## What’s new

Adds new values to the [Issuing Transaction](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/transactions/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20) `purchase_details.fuel.unit` enum:

- `imperial_gallon`
- `kilogram`
- `pound`
- `charging_minute`
- `kilowatt_hour`

## Impact

Adds new values to the [purchase_details.fuel.unit](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/transactions/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20#issuing_transaction_object-purchase_details-fuel-unit) property for the [Issuing Transaction](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/transactions.md?api-version=2024-06-20) resource.

2. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
- If you don’t use an SDK, update your [API requests](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include `Stripe-Version: 2024-06-20`
3. Upgrade the API version used for [webhook endpoints](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4. [Test your integration](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
